translation: Mme a romela ⟨את⟩ bashanyana ba ba tswang mo baneng ba Yisraele, mme ba tlhagisa dikabelo tsa go chesa, mme ba tlhagisa dikabelo tsa kagiso tsa ditonki tse nne tsa ditonki tse nne tsa ⟨את⟩ dikabelo tsa kagiso tsa ditonki — ba ne ba dira jalo go Yahwe: E ne e le dikabelo tsa kagiso tsa ditonki tse nne tsa kgomo.
